notes.title: Guangzhou video Game Museum, we are waiting for you here！
notes.content:
[h2] Have a great weekend, guys! Developed by TENGO PROJECT of NatsumeAtari in Japan, the special exhibition of "KAGE ~ Shadow of the Ninja Shadowwarrior" is currently in progress at Guangzhou "Wanwuyuan Video Game Museum"!

Whether you are an experienced player or a new friend who is just getting into the game culture, you can go to the All Things Breaking Video Game Museum to try out games and exchange ideas with other players.
The game is currently selling well on Steam and other platforms, Steam China limited time discount after 68.4 yuan!

"All Things Breaking Yuan Video Game Museum" : No. 110, B1 Floor, VLAB Yi Fang 181 Creative Park, 181 Shatai South Road, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province

TIPS: This special exhibition will last until September 22, opening time is 10:00-17:00 (closed every Monday, closed during Mid-Autumn Festival holiday). Be sure to purchase tickets before entering! [/h2]
